entities.name: Responsible Parenthood and Reproductive Health Act of 2012
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: The Responsible Parenthood and Reproductive Health Act of 2012, also known as the Reproductive Health Law or RH Law, and officially designated as Republic Act No. 10354, is a Philippine law that provides universal access to methods of contraception, fertility control, sexual education, and maternal care.
